entities.summary: The Komusō (虚無僧) were wandering non-monastic lay Buddhists from the warrior-class who were noted for wearing straw basket hats called tengai and playing the shakuhachi bamboo flute, nowadays called suizen . During the Edo period (1600–1868) they obtained various rights and privileges from the bakufu, the ruling elite.
